title: Report a missing item
summary: NestJS: Report a missing item. Try a custom missing-item message.
introduction: A built-in exception creates an HTTP error response. GET /missing reports a missing book.
learningObjectives: Report a missing item with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Report a missing item

blocks.text: NotFoundException stops the normal result path and creates an HTTP 404 error with the supplied message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a suitable HTTP error instead of returning a success status for a failure.
